correctness.rationale: The 35 four-subsets and all 1050 compatible five-families are exhaustively enumerated, with two checked S7 orbits (420,630). The 630-family is algebraically inconsistent; the 420-family normalizes to seven distinct GF9 points via z²-z-1=0, with exactly five harmonic tetrads. Degree-32 push-pull character maps yield a prime-to-three Jacobian isogeny; a direct Cartier determinant -(u-v)² verifies all seven genus-two quotients ordinary, implying rank 44, a-number 5, and Newton slopes.
